$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the item-kind vocabulary shared by the bridges and the CLI. Every kind string the C# ItemKind.Map can emit is listed here with its family. family source/config/folder => the CLI materializes it as a workspace file and MUST have a matching packages/volt-cli/src/registry/extensions.ts entry. family inlined => the item lives inside a POU's .st text, never a separate file. family container => a wire kind that is never materialized. Enforced by packages/volt-cli/src/tests/registry/vocabulary.test.ts, which cross-checks this file against BOTH ItemKind.cs (the bridge) and extensions.ts (the CLI): changing any one of the three without the others fails the test.
